posts.trend: IIT, IIM paychecks hit pause as median campus salaries stay flat for Class of 2027
posts.context: The skyrocketing cost of premium education makes flat entry-level salaries a financial hazard.
posts.angle: A premium MBA degree creates significant debt without matching the immediate market return.
slides: The ROI on a premium MBA now requires forty years of corporate survival.

posts.caption: Send this to the MBA grad who is still calculating their debt-to-income ratio on a Friday night. 📊
